name: Report Back to Fizzlebub

meta.previous: Get the Gnomes Drunk, Get the Goblins Drunk

summary: Kravel Koalbeard says the Fool's Stout worked great. He has put money on the next race, hoping the crew you made drunk wrecked their own car. You carry a note about the successful test to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay. This follows the pit crew you chose to make drunk.

sections.title: A Note for Crank
sections.body: Kravel Koalbeard says the Fool's Stout worked great. He has put money on the next race, hoping the pit crew you made drunk wrecked their own car. One more job remains: take a note about the successful test to Crank Fizzlebub in Booty Bay, who will want to hear of it. Kravel also hopes more of the stout can be had for future races.

sections.title: Crank's Answer
sections.body: Crank Fizzlebub reads the note, calls the test a success, and is glad of the news. Should you ever want more of the stout, Crank says to ask, and you will be set to collecting more of Zanzil's Mixture.

aliases: who gives report back to fizzlebub
faq.answer: Kravel Koalbeard, the dwarf at the Mirage Raceway on the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles, hands you the note.
It follows Get the Gnomes Drunk or, if you chose the other crew, Get the Goblins Drunk.

faq.q: What does Kravel Koalbeard want Fizzlebub to know?
faq.answer: That the test was a success.
